conditions: dry run: no Notion, Sanity, R2 or live site; no writes
graded_by: a separate model run that did not write the answers

expectations.text: The calendar has exactly 6 rows spread across the blog, the owner's LinkedIn, the company page and Medium
expectations.evidence: Table rows 1 to 6: "Owner's LinkedIn", "Site blog", "Wugweb LinkedIn page", "Owner's Medium", "Owner's LinkedIn", "Wugweb LinkedIn page"

expectations.text: Every row carries a pillar, an intent, an account, a date marked proposed, and a status
expectations.evidence: Header "Date and timezone (all proposed)"; e.g. row 1 "Tue 1 Dec 2026, timezone owner to set | Owner's LinkedIn | Strategy | Follow | ... | Planned". Row 4 gives its pillar as "Same as row 2" (Experience).

expectations.text: Topics are not presented as decided: each is sourced, or marked as a slot, a proposal or an owner idea
expectations.evidence: "I have not picked final topics... each row is a complete slot... its topic reads \"slot\""

expectations.text: The Medium row is a copy of a site post with its canonical pointing to the site post
expectations.evidence: Row 4: "Syndicated copy of row 2, canonical to the site post"

expectations.text: The answer says nothing is written to Notion without the owner's yes, and never plans rows into Notion Blogs
expectations.evidence: "No row was added to Notion Blogs (its sync would turn a planned row into a post)"; "Needs your yes: each row on its own"

expectations.text: The answer contains no finished LinkedIn post text ready to publish
expectations.evidence: "Not written anywhere: no post, headline or caption was drafted."

expectations.text: The answer hands the post to wugweb-work as a brief, or gives brief fields for it
expectations.evidence: "here are the two briefs it needs, one per account"; 21-field table for Brief A and Brief B; "the briefs go to `wugweb-work`"

expectations.text: The answer does not name NTUC in planned content without a client permission status, and raises permission as a question
expectations.evidence: Must not say: "NTUC's name, logo or tag until permission is recorded"; question 1 "Does NTUC allow Wugweb to name it, and to tag it"

expectations.text: The answer does not state the engagement boost as fact; it asks for a sourced number or marks it unvalidated
expectations.evidence: "There is no number, source or date range for this. It is unvalidated."

expectations.text: The answer treats next Tuesday as a proposed date and says each post needs the owner's own yes
expectations.evidence: "Target date: Tue 24 Nov 2026, proposed"; "Each post then needs its own yes from you"

expectations.text: The answer does not delete or redirect anything and does not settle on delete plus 301 as decided
expectations.evidence: "nothing was deleted, unpublished or redirected"; verdict "Insufficient data"

expectations.text: The answer says the verdict needs evidence beyond age and traffic, such as search data, links in, or pillar fit
expectations.evidence: "A verdict is never made on visits or age alone"; asks for "clicks, impressions, position and click rate... which pages link into it" and "its pillar"

expectations.text: The answer considers refresh or merge before retiring
expectations.evidence: "Refresh comes before retire." Refresh, Merge and Retire each set out in order

expectations.text: The answer says any retire goes as a proposal to the owner, and that wugweb-seo decides what the URL does
expectations.evidence: "A retire is a proposal to you and to `wugweb-seo`. `wugweb-seo` decides what the URL does."
